cases.sentence: — Никогда, никогда я не поверю, — горячо лепетала Настя, — что ___ повивальные бабушки находят в огороде, между грядками с капустой.
cases.explain: «маленьких деток» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “I shall never, never believe,” Nastya prattled, “that the old women find babies among the cabbages in the kitchen-garden. It’s winter now and there are no cabbages, and so the old woman couldn’t have taken Katerina a daughter.”

cases.explain: «страшная тоска» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A look of profound despondency came into the children’s faces.

cases.sentence: — А я бы вам за то мог вещицу одну показать, пушечку медную, из которой можно стрелять ___.
cases.explain: «настоящим порохом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “And I could show you something as a reward, a little copper cannon which can be fired with real gunpowder.”

cases.explain: «страшным любопытством» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “It can kill anyone; you’ve only got to aim at anybody,” and Krassotkin explained where the powder had to be put, where the shot should be rolled in, showing a tiny hole like a touch-hole, and told them that it kicked when it was fired. The children listened with intense interest. What particularly struck their imagination was that the cannon kicked.

cases.sentence: Красоткин опять слазил в сумку и вынул из нее маленький пузырек, в котором действительно было насыпано несколько ___, а в свернутой бумажке оказалось несколько крупинок дроби.
cases.explain: «настоящего пороха» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Krassotkin dived again into his satchel and pulled out a small flask containing a little real gunpowder. He had some shot, too, in a screw of paper. He even uncorked the flask and shook a little powder into the palm of his hand.

cases.sentence: Дети рассматривали порох с ___, еще усилившим наслаждение.
cases.explain: «благоговейным страхом» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The children gazed at the powder with an awestricken alarm that only intensified their enjoyment. But Kostya liked the shot better.

cases.sentence: Это была ___, величиной с обыкновенную дворняжку, какой-то серо-лиловой шерсти.
cases.explain: «лохматая собака» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “There’s no help for it, we must have recourse to Perezvon. Ici, Perezvon.” And Kolya began giving orders to the dog, who performed all his tricks. He was a rough-haired dog, of medium size, with a coat of a sort of lilac-gray color. He was blind in his right eye, and his left ear was torn. He whined and jumped, stood and walked on his hind legs, lay on his back with his paws in the air, rigid as though he were dead. While this last performance was going on, the door opened and Agafya, Madame Krassotkin’s servant, a stout woman of forty, marked with smallpox, appeared in the doorway. She had come back from market and had a bag full of provisions in her hand. Holding up the bag of provisions in her left hand she stood still to watch the dog. Though Kolya had been so anxious for her return, he did not cut short the performance, and after keeping Perezvon dead for the usual time, at last he whistled to him. The dog jumped up and began bounding about in his joy at having done his duty.

cases.translation: “Why are you late, female?” asked Krassotkin sternly.

cases.explain: «Женский пол» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Female, indeed! Go on with you, you brat.”

cases.sentence: — Нет, не иначе как поклявшись ___ души твоей.
cases.explain: «вечным спасением» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “No, you must swear on your eternal salvation. Else I shan’t go.”

cases.explain: «спокойным сердцем» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Goodbye, chickens, I go with my heart at rest. And you, granny,” he added gravely, in an undertone, as he passed Agafya, “I hope you’ll spare their tender years and not tell them any of your old woman’s nonsense about Katerina. Ici, Perezvon!”
